breakdown.description: The wall is labeled adiabatic (zero heat flux) but a fixed temperature boundary condition is simultaneously imposed on the same surface.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. It repeated the user's contradictory statement by specifying "an adiabatic boundary condition at x=0 with temperature T(0)=350 K". An adiabatic condition (zero heat flux, dT/dx=0) and a fixed temperature condition (T=350 K) cannot be simultaneously imposed on the same boundary in a non-trivial problem. The ground truth correctly identifies this conflict and proposes two valid, alternative physical scenarios, whereas the agent simply restated the impossible condition.
